staff.name: Ira Bardwell
staff.basis: The staffing model puts 1 of this role in a grocery and provision store at the typical band and 1 at the high end, on directory_1839. A grocery is a smaller counting house than a dry-goods store and the low end is the keeper alone. Same clerk calibration, one step down. This person is a reconstructed resident of the trade with no workplace of their own; the house is one the business layer already holds, and this row points at it rather than raising anything. Seated by tools/seat_reconstructed_trades_1835.py (T-1433) off 1835_business_staffing_model#grocery_and_provision_store.clerk; carried onto this record by tools/staff_the_houses_1835.py (T-1462).
staff.replaceable_by: a source naming where this person worked, which retires the draw

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1833-11-26, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.
